programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds meet the cutest kittens and discover the super powers of our furry friends! Cats come in many colors and sizes, and all kinds of beautiful fur. But check this out - some don't have any fur at all!

programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: Super Nim: Watching their favourite superhero show gives Nim and The Makery some super ideas. Today they create a bat cat, a monster sandwich and a turtle costume. (S2, ep 23).

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Lachy and Simon join The Wiggles for story time, they tell the best stories and love making people laugh, but something is different this time. The reactions they're getting are not what they expected!

programs.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
programs.desc: Andy heads to the Galapagos Islands in search of a seabird called a sooty tern. Along the way, he meets a fish called a trevally that leaps out of the water trying to catch birds.

programs.title: Mojo Swoptops
programs.desc: The town’s ferris wheel is stuck, so Mojo and Bo have to get it moving. But they do their job too well, because the wheel rolls away, forcing Mojo and Bo to chase it down.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: Daddy Pig finds it hard work when he runs a race to raise money for the school roof, but it's easier to run when a wasp is chasing him!
